trace_summary.task_objective: A fixed three-hop retrieval pipeline over Wikipedia abstracts that performs exactly three retrievals and returns the concatenation of everything retrieved. The claim to verify is: 'Max Gail starred in the film that Jim Moody played Arnie in. He also had a role in the TV series Carl Levitt.'
trace_summary.final_output_summary: The pipeline completed all three hops and returned 24 documents. Hop 1 retrieved documents about Jim Moody (who played Arnie in D.C. Cab), Max Gail (who starred in Barney Miller), and Ron Carey (who played Carl Levitt on Barney Miller). Hop 2 retrieved documents confirming Max Gail starred in D.C. Cab. Hop 3 retrieved documents about Barney Miller cast members.
trace_summary.summary: The three-hop retrieval pipeline executed as specified, completing all three retrievals and returning 24 documents. The first hop retrieved key documents establishing that Jim Moody played Arnie in D.C. Cab and that Max Gail was a star of Barney Miller. Cab Wikipedia page confirming Max Gail starred in that film. The third hop attempted to verify the Barney Miller connection. All required steps executed, and the pipeline returned the concatenated document list as specified. The summarizers correctly analyzed the evidence, and the query generators produced reasonable queries given their inputs. No structural failures occurred.
